changes.title: Legend circle music
items: Step into a sleeping legend's clearing on the ground and the music goes muffled while the legend's own mysterious music rises over it, different for every kind of legend

changes.title: Legend clearings
items: Every sleeping legend now lies in a small round clearing of its own, near the top of the circle, a ring of trodden earth and pale stones marking its edge

changes.title: Moon
items: Before the first wave the dancefloor shows only the moon, going through its phases in soft twilight colours, and the full moon flares out into the party when the first wave comes
The moon in the sky now moves slowly across it over a run, waxes and wanes, and once in a while turns red, blue or harvest gold, tinting the moonlight a little
